SAFETY. Back-translation: 'I have need of ___, please.' 'Di' merges with a definite article (del, dell', della), so the blank can need adjusting; with 'un/una' it stays 'di un taxi'. For a doctor the app reuses the vetted need_doctor phrase. In a real emergency shout 'Aiuto!' (ah-YOO-toh).
The blank takes 'un' or 'una' + noun by gender (un bagno, una farmacia), so the article is inside the blank. 'Qui vicino' = 'near here'.
